usage: cli.py replay [-h] [--cfg CFG] --prices PRICES [--store STORE]
                     --start START --end END [--out OUT] [--no-clobber]
                     [--session {premarket,open,midday,close,afterhours}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cfg CFG             Path to regime config
  --prices PRICES       Path to prices CSV
  --store STORE         Store directory
  --start START         Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --end END             End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --out OUT             Optional output CSV path
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
  --session {premarket,open,midday,close,afterhours}
